parameters.query:
WITH candidates AS (
SELECT o.id offer_id,d.id demand_id,
( CASE WHEN o.product=d.product THEN 40 ELSE 0 END
+ CASE WHEN o.quantity_kg>=d.quantity_kg THEN 20 ELSE 10 END
+ CASE WHEN d.max_unit_price IS NULL OR o.unit_price IS NULL OR o.unit_price<=d.max_unit_price THEN 20 ELSE 0 END
+ CASE WHEN d.needed_date IS NULL OR o.ready_date IS NULL OR o.ready_date<=d.needed_date THEN 10 ELSE 0 END
+ CASE WHEN d.min_quality IS NULL OR o.quality=d.min_quality THEN 10 ELSE 0 END
) score
FROM offers o JOIN demands d ON o.product=d.product
WHERE o.status='فعال' AND d.status='فعال'
)
INSERT INTO matches(offer_id,demand_id,score,reasons)
SELECT offer_id,demand_id,score,jsonb_build_object('روش','تطبیق اولیه بر اساس محصول، مقدار، قیمت، زمان و کیفیت')
FROM candidates WHERE score>=70
ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
RETURNING *;
